scenes.title: A Rib Fracture
scenes.summary: A doctor diagnoses Chef Barinov with a cracked rib after a heavy wardrobe fell on him.

scenes.title: Only the Truth
scenes.summary: Max publicly vows in front of the kitchen crew to stop lying and speak only the truth to win back Vika's trust.

scenes.title: Ainura's Niece and the Old Suit
scenes.summary: Ainura introduces her niece Gulnara to Lyova on her first day, while Elena discovers Viktor's ten-year-old suit.

scenes.title: The Bet About the Suit
scenes.summary: Viktor gets defensive about his weight when his old suit feels tight and promises Elena it will fit loosely in a week.

scenes.title: The Missing Truffles
scenes.summary: Max truthfully reveals where Senya hid the missing truffles, and Senya pretends he was testing Lyova's vigilance.

scenes.title: The Chef on a Diet
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov turns down staff food because of his diet and gets angry when Max honestly tells him he is overweight.

scenes.title: A Compliment in Kyrgyz
scenes.summary: Lyova asks for a Kyrgyz translation to impress Gulya, while Chef Barinov grows irritable from his celery diet.

scenes.title: A Rebel on a Diet
scenes.summary: Senya teases Chef Barinov that Elena put him on a diet, making Viktor insecure about whether Elena thinks he is fat.

scenes.title: A Bad Prank
scenes.summary: After a fake Kyrgyz translation gets Lyova slapped by Gulya, Ainura apologizes and offers to pass Gulya a date invitation.

scenes.title: The Baby Crib and the Cognac
scenes.summary: Kostya hides a broken bottle of cognac at the bar while a baby crib is mistakenly delivered to the hotel for Vika and Max.

scenes.title: Max's Honest Answer
scenes.summary: Max refuses to lie for Kostya about the broken cognac, earning Vika's permission to help take the baby crib home.

scenes.title: The Tailor, the Date, and Prigozhin
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov secretly has a tailor widen his suit, Ainura brings news of Gulya's answer, and Max is hit by Iosif Prigozhin's car.

scenes.title: Low-Quality Lying
scenes.summary: Vika refuses to believe Max's true story about being hit by Iosif Prigozhin's car while chasing a thief.

scenes.title: The Weight-Loss Diary
scenes.summary: Elena starts recording Viktor's daily weight and photographing his stomach, threatening to expose his secret visit to the tailor.

scenes.title: Ainura's Secret Admirer
scenes.summary: Lyova sets up a romantic table with musicians for Gulya, but Ainura sits down believing Lyova invited her.

scenes.title: Champagne for Lovers
scenes.summary: Ainura gently tells Lyova that he is not her type and encourages him to court her niece Gulnara instead.

scenes.title: Elena's Toast
scenes.summary: Elena tells Viktor she loves him regardless of his weight, relieving him from his miserable week of dieting.

scenes.title: Iosif Prigozhin's Moustache
scenes.summary: Max brings Iosif Prigozhin wearing a prop moustache from a video shoot, causing Vika to mistake him for a hired lookalike.

scenes.title: We Are Having a Girl
scenes.summary: When Vika realizes Iosif Prigozhin is real and Max told the truth, she apologizes and tells Max they are having a baby girl.
